active_change.public_api: support-only typed similarity witness and analogy-discovery diagnostics

theory_and_paper.novelty_boundary: Mechanism-aligned analogy retrieval, cross-analogy confirmation, stage-decomposed discovery, multi-stage analogy annotation, abstraction-assisted mapping and structure-guided retrieval are prior art. RAKL retains a narrower evidence-governed four-gate discovery ledger and authority boundary as an internal candidate contribution, pending real retrieval evidence and prior-art attack.

saturation.reason: The retrieval/recognition theory is now executable and benchmarkable, but real far-domain retrieval has not yet been compared under matched routes.

next_ai.positive: Freeze a real scientific-paper corpus with expert-validated far-domain analogues, hidden labels and surface-plausible near-misses; compare lexical, embedding, domain-stripped relational and graph/structural routes under matched top-k/model/cost budgets.
next_ai.null: If lexical+embedding matches richer routes on the frozen real corpus, keep structural retrieval routes optional and preserve the null rather than adding mandatory complexity.
next_ai.refuted: If the four-gate diagnostic mislabels known failures or the witness contract rejects valid relation classes, preserve the counterexamples and roll back any proposed active integration.
next_ai.partial_id: If objective ground truth is available only for some relation families, benchmark those families and mark the rest CANNOT_CHECK.
next_ai.blocked: If corpus identity, hidden-label isolation, exact-head CI or current-main identity cannot be observed, do not treat the affected result as promotion evidence.
next_ai.transport: If main moves during the next candidate run, rebase/rebuild against the new head without force updates and without changing frozen predictions.
